seoDescription: Milwaukee Public Schools starts Sept. 1, 2027 and ends June 8, 2028. See MPS breaks, staff days, makeup dates, the official PDF, and an ICS download.
heroSummary: The first day of school for Milwaukee Public Schools is Wednesday, September 1, 2027, and the last day is Thursday, June 8, 2028. MPS lists 176 student days and 191 staff days. Winter Break runs December 22–31, and Spring Break runs April 3–7. June 12–13 are reserved as emergency makeup days only if needed.

allDatesCoverageNote: This table lists districtwide attendance dates, student no-school days, staff workdays, and the two conditional emergency makeup dates published by MPS. Individual schools may add non-attendance days.
breaksTitle: MPS Breaks and When Students Return

2027-11-24.name: Thanksgiving Break
2027-11-24.note: Students are also off Tuesday, November 23. Classes resume Monday, November 29.

groups.label: No February Break on the 2027–28 calendar
items: The 2027–28 MPS calendar does not list a February Break. Students are instead off Friday, February 25 for a professional-development day, when most staff report. The previous 2026–27 calendar had a one-day February Break on February 22.

groups.label: Students and staff are off on conference days
items: MPS lists October 22 and March 24 as Parent-Teacher Conference Days when both students and staff do not report.

groups.label: Students are off November 23–26
items: November 23 is a professional-development day when most staff report. November 24–26 are Thanksgiving Break, when students and school staff do not report.

groups.label: June 12–13 are reserve dates only
items: The two emergency makeup days apply only if MPS activates them. They remain visible for planning but are excluded from the ICS download.

customSections.label: Summer Academy Is Separate from the Regular School Year
customSections.content: The 2027–28 PDF lists 20 Summer Academy days from July 5–29, followed by a Summer Academy staff record day on July 30. MPS's calendar webpage summarizes Summer Academy as July 5–30. This page follows the PDF for the distinction between student program days and the July 30 staff record day. Summer Academy is separate from the regular 176-day student calendar.

customSections.label: Minor Typo in the Hmong Calendar Grid
customSections.content: The Hmong page appears to show “0” where April 10 should appear in the April 2028 calendar grid. The English page shows April 10 correctly, and no closure is marked for that date. Dates on this page therefore follow the English calendar page when the translated grid differs.

calendarFaqs.q: Is this the Milwaukee or Minneapolis MPS calendar?
calendarFaqs.a: This page covers Milwaukee Public Schools in Wisconsin. Minneapolis Public Schools has a separate calendar page.

calendarFaqs.q: When does Milwaukee MPS start school in 2027?
calendarFaqs.a: The first day for students is Wednesday, September 1, 2027. August 25–27 and August 30–31 are staff workdays, not student attendance days.

calendarFaqs.q: When is Milwaukee MPS Winter Break in 2027–28?
calendarFaqs.a: Winter Break runs December 22 through December 31, 2027. Classes resume Monday, January 3, 2028.

calendarFaqs.q: When is Milwaukee MPS Spring Break in 2028?
calendarFaqs.a: Spring Break runs April 3 through April 7, 2028. Classes resume Monday, April 10.

calendarFaqs.q: Does Milwaukee MPS have a February Break in 2028?
calendarFaqs.a: No. The 2027–28 PDF does not list a February Break. Students instead have no school Friday, February 25, for professional development.

calendarFaqs.q: When is the last day of Milwaukee MPS in 2028?
calendarFaqs.a: The last day of school is Thursday, June 8, 2028. June 9 is a staff record day.

calendarFaqs.q: Are June 12–13 confirmed Milwaukee MPS school days?
calendarFaqs.a: No. MPS reserves June 12–13 as emergency makeup days only if needed. They are excluded from this site's ICS download unless MPS activates them.
